'''October 2001 Livonia tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in RIW, Livonia, Michigan on 20 October 2001. [[Nick Glazer]] won it. It is known from Andrew Ehret's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3064">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-20-livonia-michigan-on-october-202001d3064/ livonia-michigan-on-october-202001], DeckTech (Andrew "Gwaihir" Ehret, 20 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-20-livonia-michigan-on-october-202001d3064/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 October 2001
* '''Site:''' RIW, Livonia, Michigan
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 25
* '''Winner:''' [[Nick Glazer]]
